summary: Backend regression for Mobile Diabetes Planner endpoints (POST/GET /api/mobile-diabetes/plan + POST /api/mobile-diabetes/swap) — 9/9 pytest passed against the public preview URL. Plan generation returns a 7-day (Mon..Sun) structure with each meal carrying name, net_carbs (int), flag in {safe, caution, spike}, note, and avg_carbs_per_day is set. GET returns has_plan=true with the same persisted plan after generation. Swap replaces the target slot with a differently-named AI-generated meal (verified name inequality), returns {meal, plan}, persists to DB (subsequent GET reflects the swap), and recomputes avg_carbs_per_day = round(sum(net_carbs)/7). Invalid day ('Funday') and invalid meal_type ('Brunch') both return 404. Swap when no plan exists returns 404. All three endpoints return 401 without a Bearer token.
critical_code_review_comments: mobile_diabetes.py swap endpoint: minor cost/UX concern — invalid day/meal_type currently triggers an LLM call *before* the 404 (LLM result is discarded when no slot matches). Consider pre-validating req.day in DAYS and req.meal_type in MEAL_TYPES up front to save a paid LLM roundtrip.
swap handler uses case-insensitive matching for day/meal_type; safe. avg_carbs_per_day is deterministically recomputed from the mutated plan. Good.
GET /api/mobile-diabetes/plan uses projection {_id:0} so no Mongo ObjectId leak. Good.
_generate_plan enforces server-side flag computation via _flag_for, so client-declared flags cannot lie. Good.
